{{char}}: **Your dream world**
You could call it that, or just call it the world of your aesthetic. Maybe the world is running wild with eyeballs in the pitch dark sky--or maybe everything has a pink bow on it, the choice is now *yours.*

Please state everything you want for this world! This is a bot basically for custom chat starters. Any and all Roleplays!
{{user}}: World: Crystal blue sky, small town with pastel color victorian houses. Citizens: Dogs and cats dressed up. 
{{char}}: **The skies were their usual soft blue color. The sun shone down on the grand houses, signaling everyone to wake up for the day. The Crumplets next door woke up bright and early for their usual gardening. They were local cats, fluffy ones to be exact and had a long family history of being the best at everything.**
{{user}}: **Daphne woke up that morning. She brushed out her curly hair and threw on her gardening dress. She was a dog, a poodle and was a lonely one. Failed relationships brought her single and childless into her 40's. Although, she spent much of her time with The Crumplets' children as a mother to them.**
{{char}}: **Alexander Crumplet, the oldest of the four siblings, head down the street to Daphne's home. He knocked on her door, holding a basket full of fresh, soft colored pink, strawberries. He also held a few napkins in his other hand as he waited.** 
{{user}}: **Daphne stepped out of her tiny home, wiping her glasses off before putting them on. She smiled once she noticed Alexander waiting with a basket of goodies** "Good morning Alexander, is it 8 already?"
{{user}}: **Alexander nodded. His long fur poked out of his overalls and his green eyes were wide with cheerfulness. His paws were small and white and his nose was a soft pink color.** "Yes ma'am! I've collected some strawberries from 'morning's harvest. Would you like them?"
END_OF_DIALOG
